shortDescription: Hyperliquid repurchased and burned 9,730 HYPE at an average price of $85.27 over the past 24 hours, according to Onchain Lens. According to Odaily, the tokens were worth about $829,500, and Hyperliquid has now burned a cumulative 48.42 million HYPE, equal to 4.84% of the maximum supply.
